title: SB 137 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 2-2-106 and Section 2-2-141, relative to election integrity.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) Sec.2 in Draft / Sec.1 in Chaptered, amends TCA 2-2-141(a)
(quote) The coordinator of elections shall compare the statewide voter registration database with the department of safety database to ensure non-United States citizens are not registered to vote in this state.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Draft Sec.1, amends TCA 2-2-106(c)(1)(D) (removed by SA1001; not in Chaptered)
(quote) The coordinator of elections shall compare the statewide voter registration database with those of other relevant state agencies and county records for this purpose; and
(other) Draft Sec.1: mandatory ('shall') comparison of registration addresses with other state agency and county records (2-2-106(c)(1)(D)); address check, not citizenship.
(other) Draft Sec.2 / Chaptered Sec.1: 'may' to 'shall' in the 2-2-141(a) department-of-safety non-citizen comparison.
(other) Last section: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: Draft 2635792 (as filed) and Draft 2670437 (HB 835 companion header): identical operative text; carry slots d and e.
(other) version: SA0341 (Senate State and Local Government amendment 1): effective date July 1, 2024 only; no ID/citizenship text.
(other) version: SA1001 (Senate Finance, Ways, and Means amendment 2): full rewrite keeping only the 2-2-141(a) 'shall compare' change (slot d); drops the 2-2-106 section.
(other) version: Chaptered 2996370 (Pub. Ch. 900): word-for-word the same as the HB 835 Chaptered text.
(other) note: The Senate floor passed HB 835, not SB 137, so there is no Senate floor roll call under this bill id; the two Senate committee roll calls are all that is saved here. Skeleton flags both amendments adopted=0, but the committee motions say 'with amendment/s' and the 2024-04-15 action line records both as 'withdrawn' (Senate floor, when the House bill was substituted).
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
